Class APRequestDaoImpl

java.lang.Object
es.uji.ei1027.ei102725gbgs.dao.APRequestDaoImpl
@Repository public class APRequestDaoImpl extends Object
Data Access Object implementation for APRequest entities.

Provides JDBC-based persistence operations for personal assistance requests stored in the database. The primary key type is Integer.
